cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Confess First
cards.instruction: Get someone else to confess or incriminate themselves before you reveal anything.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've put a hand up on the video call, so I've put mine up. You can go first about Mum's missed booking.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's the goodbye button. I have to go. What happened to her present?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, goodbye at the end. First, did you forget to book, or decide I would do it?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I assumed you'd do it. Can you answer me now?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: After this: you told Mum it was confirmed, didn't you? Say that before you press goodbye, then I'll tell you about the present.

reason: Make the borrowed misunderstanding concrete while preserving the Drive-specific response to each actual partner contribution. D18 retains useful original beats rather than replacing effective material unnecessarily.
